question: Which of the following is not a limitation of the crystal field theory ?

options.A: It assumes that ligands are point charges.
options.B: It does not take into account the covalent character of bonding between ligand and the central atom.
options.C: Formation of structures, colour and magnetic properties can be explained by the crystal field theory.
options.D: All of the above are limitations of crystal field theory. CC06 - 0818

explanation: Ans. ( 3 ) The crystal field model is successful in explaining the formation, structures, colour and magnetic properties of coordination compounds to a large extent. However, from the assumptions that the ligands are point charges, it follows that anionic ligands should exert the greatest splitting effect. The anionic ligands actually are found at the low end of the spectrochemical series. Further, it does not take into account the covalent character of bonding between the ligand and the central atom.
